text: Upgrade invoicer from Brambleway API v2 to v3. Keep the public interface of InvoicerClient. All tests and mypy must pass.

Base URL and error mapping are small, so I'll do them here. Pagination and auth each have their own module and tests, so two subagents can take them in parallel.

Bearer exchange lives in auth.py, token cached per process; X-Bw-Key is gone from 3 files. Reading .env.production was denied, so the client ID comes from settings.BRAMBLEWAY_CLIENT_ID.

Both are back. I'll wire the bearer headers into the request path, then run the client suite.
The page fixtures still have the v2 shape, with next_page and no next_cursor. The client code is right; the fixtures are stale.
